fullTextBlocks: Animates numbers with a smooth vertical rolling effect when they enter the viewport.
Add the train-counter class to a Text Block or Div Block.
Enter your desired number, such as 250, 1,500, or 99.9%.
Ensure GSAP and ScrollTrigger are loaded on the page.
Add the custom counter script to your site.
Creates an infinite card slider synchronized with a rolling number counter.
Add card-hero-wrap to the main wrapper.
Add hero-card-wrapper to the card container.
Add hero-card-box to each card (at least two cards required).
Add conter-namber to the number counter element.
Ensure GSAP is loaded on the page.
Note: The cards slide horizontally while the counter digits animate vertically in a continuous loop.
Creates a smooth, animated accordion that expands and collapses FAQ items when clicked.
Add financial-benefits-card-faq-box to the main wrapper.
Add financial-benefits-faq to each FAQ item.
Add faq-toggle-content to the collapsible answer.
Add faq-item-icon to the toggle icon.
Note: Only one FAQ item stays open at a time. Add financial-benefits-faq-active to an item to make it open by default.
Adds smooth, inertia-based scrolling across every page using the open-source Lenis library (MIT license). The code lives in Site Settings > Custom Code.
The Lenis stylesheet is loaded in the Head Code: https://unpkg.com/lenis@1.1.14/dist/lenis.css
The Lenis script and the setup below are loaded in the Footer Code (before </body>).
Change lerp to adjust smoothness: lower values (for example 0.05) feel smoother, higher values (for example 0.15) feel more direct.
No classes or attributes are needed. Add data-lenis-prevent to any scrollable element (such as a modal or dropdown) that should keep native scrolling.
Note: To turn smooth scrolling off, delete the Lenis stylesheet from the Head Code and the Lenis script block from the Footer Code.
